faq.q1: What is included in a package?
faq.a1: Furniture for every room of the apartment type, plus delivery and installation. The room-by-room list is on each package page.
faq.q2: I live abroad. Can I do this remotely?
faq.a2: Yes. Many buyers are not in Cyprus at handover. Concept, selection and approval happen online, and we install before you arrive.
faq.a3: Same Studio, 1+1 and 2+1 structure, chosen for the purpose: durable and neutral for long-term tenants, guest-ready down to kitchenware and linen for holiday lets.
faq.a4: Yes. All prices are in GBP and start from £10,000 for a Studio, £12,000 for a 1+1 and £14,000 for a 2+1.

faqPackages.q1: Can I change pieces in a package?
faqPackages.a1: Yes. The package sets the scope and the starting price; you approve every piece before delivery.
faqPackages.q2: Do prices include delivery and installation?
faqPackages.a2: Yes. Every package price includes delivery to the apartment and installation by our team.
